data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 shares mechanism with SRC_003: both ground the solution in the same three-stage digit exhaustion (9 digits for 1–9, 180 for 10–99, 603 for 3-digit pages) and derive 300. It is REFUTED IF SRC_003's mechanism omits the digit-length boundary at 99 (the transition from 2-digit to 3-digit allocation) that is essential to SRC_006's procedure, or if SRC_003 skips the 189-digit consumption step.
